scientific_integrity.date_evidence: Publisher explicitly reports first publication of motivating Yang–Xing article on 2005-11-17; older contextual works have only month/year public-preprint evidence in accessible records.
scientific_integrity.source_access: Accessible full-text methods for Putora et al. (2012) and Shinde et al. (2025) were inspected; other relevant full papers were inaccessible, with risk documented.
scientific_integrity.theorem_support: complete analytic proof plus supplementary finite numerical checks

scientific_limitations: The result is a mathematical two-tissue weighted log-damage surrogate, not a clinical treatment plan or prediction of clinical outcome.
The three instantaneous fractions have equal fixed doses, anchored first and last times, and a strictly ordered pair of single-exponential repair rates.
Endpoint doublets are idealized and may be prohibited by treatment delivery; a positive minimum-gap version is proved.
Repopulation, reoxygenation, multirate repair, uncertainty, treatment constraints and patient-calibrated weights are absent.
Historical priority against broader and some inaccessible primary texts remains provisional.
title: A sharp symmetry-breaking phase diagram for three equally sized fractions under competing exponential repair
